$comment: The official Mystic Paradox launcher's servers and public keys (no secrets). Applied ONLY on purpose, by scripts/use-build-profile.ps1 (the official release workflow and npm run release:launcher). A build without a profile names no server: a release build then needs MYSTICPARADOX_API_BASE_URL and MYSTICPARADOX_RUNTIME_PUBLIC_KEY_B64 (scripts/configure-selfhost.ps1 sets them for a self-hosted server) and checks no launcher updates.
name: official

security.csp: default-src 'self'; connect-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost https://paradox.mysticfox.dev https://api.mysticfox.dev; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data:; script-src 'self'
